content.label: I would be using Wispr Flow to write this review from my M1 iPad Pro but I can’t consistently activate it. Could be user error, but I don’t think so. Otherwise, everywhere else I use the app it’s great! So far, I’ve dictated over 200K words in the 3-4 months I’ve used it. If they can improve on the iPad experience this would easily be a 5/5 app.
